_comment: Example kit presets of the Cargo bike tab. Prices are estimates in 2024 EUR (German prices, converted to the start point's country like the other prices); replace them with the real kit list. Each kit sets parameters of assumptions/parameters.yaml by key without the cargo_bike. prefix; tools/cargo-bike/export_defaults.py checks the keys and copies the kits to crates/cargo-bike/data/defaults.json.
